messages:
maria_cs: Quick ask — ZenithHealth wants a concise runbook + comms handback for their onboarding. They need: uptime SLO, p99 latency targets, and a simple example of how credits would be calculated if we miss. Also flag any renewal risk if we amend the SLO during onboarding.

sam_sre: Got it. I can draft the runbook bullets and a calc snippet. Do we have the baseline numbers they signed up to?

josh_cs: They signed the starter plan: 99.9% uptime across their dedicated pool, p99 latency 550ms for text-generation endpoints (per route). We agreed a 30-day onboarding window with monitoring.

anika_pm: Important: the onboarding window includes phased rollouts. If we change SLOs mid-onboard we should record consent and impact on renewal. That falls under renewal risk.

maria_cs: Perfect. Draft should include: 1) what we monitor, 2) escalation steps, 3) credit calc example, 4) customer-facing comms template. Keep it short — they'll paste into their procurement folder.

sam_sre: Drafting now. Quick note on calc: we follow the standard credit banding (per contract). Example approach below.

sam_sre: ```
# Example uptime credit calc (sample numbers)
Contract uptime: 99.9% (monthly)
Observed uptime: 99.5%
Downtime minutes = (1 - 0.995) * 30 * 24 * 60 = 21.6 minutes
Credit band: 99.0% - 99.9% => 10% service credit
Monthly invoice = $10,000 -> credit = $1,000
```

josh_cs: Nice. Could we add a latency credit example too? Some customers want credits tied to p99.

sam_sre: Sure. Simple version: if p99 > target for > X% of requests in the billing window, apply tiered credit. Example:

sam_sre: ```
# Latency credit example
Target p99: 550ms
Observed p99: 800ms
Condition: p99 > target for >= 5% of monitored periods -> 5% credit
Invoice $10k -> credit $500
```

anika_pm: Add note: latency credits should be gated by a root-cause check. If increased latency is due to customer-configured model (larger context window) or a self-hosted private deployment setting, credits may not apply.

rachel_legal: Agree. Also include the requirement to capture evidence (traces, dashboards) and a sync with legal for non-standard credits. Keep language non-committal until legal signs off on any custom credit.

maria_cs: Good call. Include an evidence checklist: dashboard snapshot, request ID sample, timeframe, feature flags, and cust confirmation of no config changes.

sam_sre: Will do. I'll also add an internal escalation flow: pager -> eng-sre runbooks -> ops lead -> cs lead -> legal if invoking credits. Add timing SLAs for each hop (5m, 30m, 2h).

josh_cs: Can you add a short customer-facing comms template? One paragraph + what we do next + CTA for the customer.

sam_sre: Draft comms below.

sam_sre: "Hi <Zenith contact>, we detected an incident that impacted your service availability between <start> and <end>. Our team is investigating and will provide a timeline for remediation within 2 hours. We will follow up with an evidence bundle and proposed credit calculation if the incident meets the contract credit criteria. Please reply if you observed related behavior or made config changes during this period. — Redwood Support"

maria_cs: This is great. Last bit — renewal risk note for the account team: if onboarding repeatedly shows repeated SLO misses, escalate to customer success manager + sales for possible contractual remediation. Document churn indicators: repeated post-onboard latency spikes, repeated capacity overruns, or inability to agree on mitigations.

anika_pm: I'll attach a short checkbox list for enablement: 1) Ensure Zenith has onboarding observability dashboard access, 2) Shared alert thresholds, 3) Weekly sync until 30 days post-prod.

rachel_legal: I'll prep a one-paragraph legal blurb we can paste into the comms so we don't promise specific credits in the initial message.

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-442. Assigned: sam_sre.

maria_cs: Awesome — thanks everyone. Sam, can you drop the final runbook + comms snippet in this thread by EOD? I'll copy to the customer folder and brief the CSM. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: Yep — will post final by 17:30 PT.

josh_cs: Thanks team.
